description: 9 steps of a survival player at a composter with a comparator behind it: a seed into an empty composter (always a layer), dirt placed on it, pumpkin pies until level 7 (each a layer, used up), a pie at level 7 taking nothing, ready a second later, emptied by hand dropping its bone meal; the level, the held stack, the dust's power and the level events (1500 with 1 or 0) the player receives; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
